description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what just happened" with a US public company. Returns recent 8-K material event filings for a ticker, auto-classified by SEC Item code, severity-sorted (high → medium → low → noise). Use when an agent asks "did Apple file anything?" / "what's new with NVDA?" / "any 8-Ks for $TSLA this week?". Faster + more structured than EDGAR's raw filing list.

days.description: Look-back window in days. Default 30, max 90.

limit.description: Max filings to return. Default 20, max 100.

name: sec_8k_recent
title: Sec 8k Recent
